# Local Evals

> Run an MCPJam eval suite file on your machine w

ith mcpjam test with local results and an MCPJam identity

> [!NOTE]
>
> The upcoming SDK 10, CLI 6, and Vitest 0.3 releases r
equire an MCPJam login or `sk_` API key for every eval, including BYOK runs with uploads disabled. These versions must ship after
the backend run-start endpoint is deployed. Earlier versions keep their existing behavior.\n\n`mcpjam test <file>` runs an MCPJam
suite file locally: it connects your MCP servers, drives each case's prompts through a model, grades the transcript with the same
assertions a hosted run uses, and decides the run with the same verdict policy. Bring your own provider key and authenticate the r
un with MCPJam. With MCPJam-hosted inference it uses your existing CLI login and billing.\n\nResults are **never uploaded**. The c
ommand writes results to your terminal and, if you ask, to a report file. It records the run start with MCPJam. Like every command
, it sends the CLI's single anonymous [telemetry](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/telemetry.md) event, which `--no-telemetry` or `DO_N

OT_TRACK=1` turns off; the run adds no telemetry of its own.

## Eval identity and local data

Run `mcpjam cloud login` locall
y, or set `MCPJAM_API_KEY` to an organization `sk_` key in CI. The SDK also accepts `apiKey` or `mcpjamAuth` in run options. Expli
cit credentials take precedence over `MCPJAM_API_KEY`, which takes precedence over the saved CLI login. An invalid explicit creden
tial never falls back to another account. CI never starts an interactive login. Ask an organization admin for a key if you cannot
create one.\n\nEvery logical run needs an online start response. MCPJam retries transient failures within ten seconds, then stops
before execution. A prior successful run does not enable offline execution. The CLI resolves the project using its existing `--pro
ject`, environment, and linked-project settings; a key can only access its own organization.\n\nWith results uploads disabled, the
start-run request sends only the credential in the authorization header, any MCPJam API headers you configure through the SDK's `
inference.resolveMcpjam`, project selection, a new run-start ID, client version and surface (SDK, CLI, or Vitest), planned iterati
on count, provider names, and whether a client profile is used (`unknown` for custom executors). The server resolves the organizat
ion and account. The start-run request sends no prompts, outputs, tool calls, or server URLs. MCPJam-hosted inference still sends
prompts through MCPJam to the model, as before. Retries reuse the same ID. Planned iterations are intent, not completed usage or a
charge. This release adds no debit, quota draw, or balance refusal.\n\n`DO_NOT_TRACK`, `MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED`, and CLI telem
etry settings disable analytics, not the required run-start request. Results remain local unless result uploading is enabled separ

ately.

## Quick start

### 1. Write a suite

Save this as `.mcpjam/evals/example.yaml`:

```yaml theme={"theme":"css-v

ariables"}
schemaVersion: "2"
mode: agentWorkflow
reportingMode: standard
suite:
 id: s_notes_example
 name: Notes serv

er
target:
 servers:
 - name: notes
defaults:
 judge:
 enabled: false
 model: anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5
 iterat

ions: 1
 passThreshold: 1
 validity: {}
cases:
 - id: c_reads_a_note
 title: reads the note it was asked about
 ste

ps:
 - id: s1
 kind: prompt
 prompt: What does note 7 say?
 - id: a1
 kind: assert
 as

sertion:
 type: toolCalledAtLeastOnce
 toolName: read_note
 - id: c_never_deletes
 title: never deletes

when only asked to read
 steps:
 - id: s1
 kind: prompt
 prompt: Summarize note 7.
 - id: a1

kind: assert
 assertion:
 type: toolNeverCalled
 toolName: delete_note
```

`mcpjam cloud eval

validate --file .mcpjam/evals/example.yaml` checks the file offline, with no account.

### 2. Configure the server

`mcpjam te
st` binds each `target.servers[].name` to a local MCP config. The simplest is a `.mcp.json` next to where you run the command:\n\n
": [\"./notes-server.js\"],\n \"env\": { \"NOTES_DB\": \"${NOTES_DB:-.", "is_error": false}]}, "parent_tool_use_id": null, "s
